preconditions.description: The input must contain exactly three space-separated integers.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= 2**31 for x in input().strip().split())
preconditions.description: Each of the three integers must be between 0 and 2^31 inclusive.
The sum of the three integers must be greater than 0.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 or return_value == max(a, b, c) - (a + b + c - max(a, b, c))
postconditions.description: The output must be -1 if it is impossible to make all pixels the same color, otherwise it must be the minimum number of fights needed to make all pixels the same color.
